areaGuide.title: Living in Cheras – Complete Guide to Room Rental, Apartment & Condominium Rental in Kuala Lumpur
areaGuide.description: Cheras is one of Kuala Lumpur's largest, most established and highly searched residential locations for room rental, apartment rental and condominium rental. Located on the border of Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, Cheras offers an excellent combination of affordability, modern residential developments, outstanding public transportation, established commercial centres and convenient access to Kuala Lumpur City Centre. Whether you are searching for a master room for rent in Cheras, a single room near MRT, a medium room for working professionals, a fully furnished condominium, a studio apartment, a serviced residence or a family-friendly apartment, Cheras provides rental options for every budget and lifestyle. The area is highly popular among university students, healthcare professionals, office workers, expatriates, young couples and families due to its excellent MRT connectivity, proximity to business districts, shopping malls, hospitals and educational institutions. Residents enjoy easy access to Taman Connaught, Bandar Tun Razak, Maluri, Sungai Besi, Bukit Jalil, KLCC, Bukit Bintang and Kuala Lumpur City Centre via the MRT Kajang Line, highways and RapidKL bus services. Popular destinations including Sunway Velocity Mall, AEON Mall Taman Maluri, Leisure Mall, EkoCheras Mall and Cheras Traders Square continue to strengthen Cheras as one of Kuala Lumpur's strongest rental property markets with consistent demand throughout the year.
